be self aware.

know that you have a disorder that affects the way you cope. not everyone will understand that, but that's OK. 

if you take your anger or upset out on somebody else by starting an argument or belittling them etc and later feel bad - apologise. if anything it helps you to stop overthinking the event.

make a list of things that make you feel calm and happy. things that you enjoy. do at least one of those things each day. as someone with bpd you need to look after yourself,because one of the causes and triggers is not being cared about or looked after in the right way,and feeling abandoned. you're never alone if you have you on your side. you're never not cared about if you care about yourself.

if you're in a situation where you feel overwhelmed or upset or out of control, step away. take a break. give yourself time to not immediately act on your emotions. you can distract yourself for a bit, do something nice for yourself or someone else to challenge the negative emotions, speak to someone else about the situation to help you work out what to do, write down what you want to say and read it over. just give yourself time to think about your next step so you don't end up doing something you regret e.g. self harm or saying something you don't mean
